# Print review and cover-disc leads

- Original source: [Print review and cover-disc leads](https://www.pcgamesdatabase.de/gameinfo.php?id=37738&sort=2)
- Author / publication: PC Games Database
- Language / date: German; dynamic index checked 2026-09-09
- Access: Record page retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: none found in the Wayback Machine (checked 2026-09-09)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete record data

The game record identifies coverage in the December 2002 issues of PC Games, PC Action, and GameStar. It also lists GameStar preview and test videos from 2002 alongside later gameplay videos.

The [GameStar 12/2002 issue index](https://www.pcgamesdatabase.de/gamestar.php?mag=gamestar&vol=12%2F2002) identifies a Robin Hood test on the cover disc. This is a bibliographic lead; the original magazine pages and video contents were not inspected.

A separate [Abandonware France issue record](https://www.abandonware-france.org/bibliotheque/magazines/joystick-3/numero-142-11091/) locates a Joystick review in issue 142, page 136, with a reported score of 6/10.

**Research use:** finding print-era material absent from modern review archives. Index dates can refer to issue or upload dates rather than the original recording date.

## Complete record data (retrieved 2026-09-09)

The supplied URL's `id=37738` selects a video entry; the game record itself is `gameinfo.php?game_id=1488`.

- Title Robin Hood: Die Legende von Sherwood; release 15.11.2002; site rating 82.3%; genre Echtzeit-Taktik; developer listed as Black Forest Games (Spellbound); publisher Wanadoo; official site robinhood-game.com; Best of 2002 rank 61; Best of All Time rank 1807. Record holds 4 videos, 7 screenshots, 3 reviews, a Pro & Contra page.
- Videos in the archive: 13.05.2024 "Robin Hood, aber auf Windows 98 - Gameplay mit HandOfBlood" (YouTube IZp4XL5SJa0); 06.03.2020 "19 Minuten Gameplay"; 20.11.2002 "Test | GameStar 12/2002 Heft-DVD Beitrag"; 20.05.2002 "Preview | GameStar 06/2002 Heft-DVD Beitrag".
- Print issues in which the game was tested: PC Games 12/2002, PC Action 12/2002, GameStar 12/2002.
- Related article: "Top 200 - Die meistgesehenen Videos des Jahres 2002" (01.01.2003).
- The site states its ratings, quotes and reviews are reproduced with permission from a long list of German outlets (4players, GameStar, PC Games, PC Action, GameZone, GamersGlobal and others).
